notes_for_editor: Height 6.0 comes from the OSM height tag, which prints as '6' with no unit; metres assumed. The brief's status 'standing' is not supported: OSM maps the object, not its condition, so it is corrected to unknown. The name suggests a Martin Luther King Jr. link, but no source says so. The latest edit note mentions downtown walking paths; the city is not named. The OSM page names no state, and the brief's Texas placement is not confirmed by any page read, so the story no longer says the outline is in Texas; the story also drops a speculative line about whom the name honors. Used 2 WebSearch calls: one for a Waco 'MLK Lookout' (no record found), one for Waco's Martin Luther King Jr. Memorial Park (event pages only; a snippet gave a 300 MLK Blvd address, not verified). Page reads: OSM way (twice), FFLA list, NHLR list. A city parks record would settle whether this is a fire lookout at all.
